opening.argument: The title offers viewers a purported free $1500 Taco Bell gift card, and the description directs them to click an external URL to obtain it. That combination presents a low-barrier reward acquisition claim and channels viewers toward an off-platform destination. The offer is therefore presented as an apparent free benefit tied to an external click. The destination, its affiliation, the conditions attached to the offer, and any payment, data request, or transaction outcome are not established, so the record supports the offer-and-click characterization without overclaiming what occurred beyond that invitation.
